fnol_text: My name is Samuel Mbeki and I live at 897 Rowan Terrace, Fairview, PA 16486. You can reach me on (555) 529-9838 or samuel.mbeki@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 31 March 2026. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2024-00122. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Mbeki on (555) 529-9838 to acknowledge the claim. Samuel confirmed the loss date as 31 March 2026.
Site visit to 897 Rowan Terrace. Neighbour Bianca Abernathy was present and confirmed the timeline.
Samuel sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
